report_comment.text: BCOR encodes a BCL6-interacting transcriptional corepressor. CCNB3 encodes cyclin B3, a regulator of cell-cycle progression. BCOR::CCNB3 is associated with a round-to-spindle-cell sarcoma group. Primary molecular analyses demonstrated the BCOR exon 15–CCNB3 exon 5 junction and inversion-associated FISH pattern, with an expression profile distinct from Ewing and CIC-rearranged sarcomas. In a molecularly confirmed BCOR::CCNB3 series, the 22 patients with follow-up had a five-year overall survival estimate of 72%, better than the historical CIC-rearranged sarcoma control cohort. Seven of nine evaluable tumors treated with Ewing-type chemotherapy showed 60–100% treatment-related necrosis or fibrosis.
